descriptor: Seed-Response Manifold Identifiability, Rank-Growth Scaling, Grassmann Subspace Stability, Held-Out Cell Transport & Finite-Seed Span Artifact Elimination

predecessor.key_result: Same-seed fingerprint replay and cross-archive identity survived, and fresh-seed fingerprints projected significantly into the P47 old-seed span. However, the training effect rank was 7 with only 8 centered seeds, exactly the algebraic maximum under row-centering.

theoretical_question: Does the seed-conditioned response geometry exhibit a stable low-dimensional core that persists as the number of prospectively sampled nominal seeds increases and across held-out representation cells, or was P48's low-dimensionality only the finite-seed rank ceiling?

seed_sets.authority: Seed integers are nominal labels; only membership in prospectively frozen sets is used.

cell_partition.universe: 64 cells = 32 vertices × valid/null using deterministic alias=ABCD[vertex_index mod 4].
cell_partition.selection_authority: Pure index rule frozen before P49 outcomes; no P48 effect-size selection.

archive_lanes.fresh_namespace: Exact P48 fresh isomorphic archive surface.
archive_lanes.purpose: Require any seed-response manifold claim to survive both seed growth and archive isomorphism.

rank_growth.object: For nested seed prefixes n∈{4,8,16,32}, compute centered seed×train-cell matrices separately for old and fresh namespaces.
rank_growth.rank_rule: Numerical rank from SVD tolerance max(shape)*eps*sigma_max; no post-hoc truncation.
rank_growth.comparison: Observed rank trajectory versus algebraic ceiling n-1.

energy_concentration.object: Fraction of Frobenius energy captured by the smallest k principal components, where k is frozen as the full rank learned at n=8 old-namespace training cells.
energy_concentration.tests: At n=16 and n=32, separately old/fresh namespace; null by 5000 common cell-coordinate permutations.
energy_concentration.meaning: Tests whether an early learned core continues to capture disproportionate response energy as seed count grows.

grassmann_stability.object: Principal-angle similarity between subspaces learned from nested n=8,16,32 seed prefixes on the same 48 train cells.
grassmann_stability.statistic: Mean squared canonical correlation between equal-rank truncated bases using the frozen n=8 rank k.
grassmann_stability.null: 5000 common cell-coordinate permutations of the larger-seed matrix.
grassmann_stability.meaning: Tests orientation stability rather than rank alone.

heldout_cell_transport.object: Project each seed's 16 held-out-cell centered fingerprint into the corresponding held-out representation induced by the seed scores learned on 48 train cells via least-squares seed-factor scores from the frozen n=8 basis.
heldout_cell_transport.statistic: Explained variance on held-out cells at n=16 and n=32, old/fresh namespace.
heldout_cell_transport.null: 5000 seed-label permutations of learned seed scores relative to held-out outcomes.
heldout_cell_transport.meaning: Separates seed generalization from representation-cell generalization.

primary_estimands.multiplicity: All inferential P49 tests are placed in one Holm FWER=0.05 family.

primary_verdict_logic.FINITE_SEED_SPAN_ARTIFACT: Rank grows to the algebraic ceiling without stable n=8 energy concentration, without Grassmann stability, and without held-out cell transport.
primary_verdict_logic.STABLE_LOW_RANK_CORE_WITH_STOCHASTIC_TAI: Rank continues to grow, but n=8 core energy concentration and Grassmann stability survive and held-out transport survives.
primary_verdict_logic.SATURATING_SEED_RESPONSE_MANIFOLD: Rank growth itself substantially saturates below ceiling by n=32, while Grassmann stability and held-out transport survive.
primary_verdict_logic.ARCHIVE_CONDITIONAL_MANIFOLD_ONLY: Core/stability/transport survive in only one archive namespace.
primary_verdict_logic.NO_IDENTIFIABLE_SEED_MANIFOLD: No coherent stable core or held-out transport survives.
primary_verdict_logic.TECHNICAL_HOLD: Any required cell has fewer than one exact-schema result because each seed×cell×namespace is sampled once.

secondary_outputs: Effective participation rank and entropy rank, descriptive only.
Cell loading maps over R/F/H/T/L representation vertices.
frozen_rules: No claim of a manifold is allowed solely because matrix rank < 64.
The n=8 rank ceiling problem from P48 is explicitly treated as a falsifier, not evidence.
Seed numbers are nominal labels; no regression on numeric seed value, distance, parity, or ordering.
No cell partition or SVD rank rule changes after outcomes.
A stable subspace is a behavioral response geometry, not a neural latent space.
Hosted provider/runtime and model identity remain confounded.
No behavioral SVEC promotion follows from P49 alone.
harvest_linkage: XLVII: uniqueness burden — low rank must survive seed-growth falsification.
XLIX: branch geometry before compression — retain full singular spectra before any scalar summary.
MQR/CUBE-REV donor: quotient and representation invariance require transport beyond the coordinate system in which the structure was discovered.
